Local browser dependencies
==========================
Files are copied from the upstream distributions listed below.
Keep these versions in sync with _config.volantis.yml. No build-time package
installation is required; static hosting serves these files from the same origin.

jquery 3.7.1
https://registry.npmjs.org/jquery/-/jquery-3.7.1.tgz
License: jquery-3.7.1/LICENSE.txt

vanilla-lazyload 19.1.3
https://registry.npmjs.org/vanilla-lazyload/-/vanilla-lazyload-19.1.3.tgz
License: vanilla-lazyload-19.1.3/LICENSE

Font Awesome Free 6.6.0
https://registry.npmjs.org/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/-/fontawesome-free-6.6.0.tgz
License: fontawesome-6.6.0/LICENSE.txt

KaTeX 0.16.22
https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/-/katex-0.16.22.tgz
License: katex-0.16.22/LICENSE
Loaded only by pages with plugins: [katex].

Mermaid 11.12.0
https://registry.npmjs.org/mermaid/-/mermaid-11.12.0.tgz
License: mermaid-11.12.0/LICENSE
Loaded only by pages with plugins: [mermaid].

Fancybox 5.0.36
https://registry.npmjs.org/@fancyapps/ui/-/ui-5.0.36.tgz
License: fancybox-5.0.36/LICENSE.md
Local compatibility assets for the upstream theme's gallery support.

Space Grotesk Medium
https://github.com/floriankarsten/space-grotesk
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/floriankarsten/space-grotesk/master/fonts/woff2/static/SpaceGrotesk-Medium.woff2
Vendored 2026-09-29, unchanged WOFF2, cover title only.
License: space-grotesk/OFL.txt (SIL Open Font License 1.1).
